description: microSD (TF) card socket, push-push, SMD, 1.68 mm high, with card-detect switch; contacts in SD order DAT2, CD/DAT3, CMD, VDD, CLK, VSS, DAT0, DAT1 (SPI: CS = CD/DAT3, DI = CMD, DO = DAT0)

datasheet.revision: DM3AT-SF-PEJM5 drawing EDC-325165-00-00 (CL0609-0031-0-00, revision 4, 2024-09-02): recommended PCB layout (mounting side), outline, contact assignment, card detection switch

package.name: Hirose DM3AT microSD socket, push-push

landPattern.page: recommended PCB layout (mounting side): contacts 0.7 x 1.2 at P = 1.1 (contact 1 nearest the switch side, 8 at 7.7 from it), card detection switch B 0.7 x 1.2 at 8.65 from contact 1 in the contact row, shell tab 1.0 x 1.2 at 1.55 beyond contact 1; left column 1.0 wide, 9.6 from contact 1: shell 1.2 high at 3.7, switch A 0.8 high at 9.9, shell 2.8 high at 14.05 below the contacts' inner edge; shell 1.3 x 1.9 at 3.25-4.55 beyond contact 1, 14.5 down. Origin at the outline's centre (13.85 x 16.15, 0.7 above the contacts' inner edge)

package.page: outline: 13.85 +-0.2 wide, 16.15 +-0.2 deep with the contacts, 1.68 +-0.15 high; the card enters from -Y (away from the contacts) and stands out about 2.4 mm when locked

pins.description: card detection switch terminal A: closes to B when a card is in

pins.name: SH
pins.description: the four shell tabs (all numbered SH): solder them, tie them to ground

notes: Cards are 3.3 V only: from a 5 V controller, shift CLK, CMD and CD/DAT3 down and DAT0 up.
SD mode (4-bit, SDIO/SDMMC): every data line and CMD pulled up (10-100 kOhm); SPI mode: CS = CD/DAT3, MOSI = CMD, SCK = CLK, MISO = DAT0, DAT1/DAT2 pulled up.
Card detect: CD_B to GND and CD_A to a GPIO with a pull-up: low with a card in.
support.page: drawing notes (card detection switch open without card, closed with card); the SD specification for the card side

notes: The drawing forbids copper in three hatched areas on the mounting side (the footprint's keepouts); keep other tracks out from under the socket too.
Put the socket at a board edge with the card slot (-Y) facing out, so a card can be pushed in and out.
